L98: ## If you want a four-year degree, we’re here to help!
L99: UMass Global has mapped its curriculum to make transferring from other colleges as fast and cost-efficient as possible; this is known as "course articulation". The mapping represents coursework that UMass Global will accept in transfer to meet course equivalencies, general education, or general elective credit. This means no wasted time or money on classes you don’t need and less stress about which classes to take when. Check out the DIY Transfer Tool to get a rough idea of what courses may transfer.
L100: It’s never too early to start planning! For a complete review of transfer credits, grab your transcripts and Connect With An Enrollment Coach.
L101: 【51†Transfer Tool†services.umassglobal.edu】
L102: ## General Education Block Transfer
L103: 
L104: Perhaps you’ve completed your general education at one or multiple colleges, and now you want to gather all those credits and apply them towards your four-year degree. UMass Global accepts a wide variety of GE credit transfers if they are completed prior to attending your first UMass Global class:
L105:   * In California, we accept CSU or UC IGETC certification
L106:   * In Massachusetts, we accept the MassTransfer Gen Ed Foundation courses in transfer
L107:   * In Washington, we accept state-approved Direct Transfer degrees
L108:   * In Oregon, we accept transfer credits
L109:   * In all other states, we accept equivalent transfer certifications

L100: ## 【28†Admissions】
L101: ## Build on the Progress You Have Already Made
L102: 
L103: Whether you completed a few college courses, earned an associate degree, or completed general education requirements, your previous coursework may help you move closer to a bachelor’s degree. UMass Global accepts eligible college credit and approved transfer pathways from community colleges and other institutions.
L104: Planning early can help you understand how your coursework may fit into your degree program. Explore the pathways below, then apply to UMass Global for free and submit unofficial transcripts to begin the evaluation process.
L105: ### General Education Block Transfer
L106: 
L107: Finished your GE courses before coming to UMass Global? UMass Global accepts CSU/UC IGETC certification in CA, MassTransfer Gen Ed Foundation courses in MA, state-approved Direct Transfer degrees in WA, and equivalent transfer certifications from other states.
L108: ### California Associate Degree for Transfer
L109: 
L110: Completed an Associate Degree for Transfer at a California community college? Eligible students are guaranteed admission at the junior level and can move into a related UMass Global bachelor’s degree without starting over.
L111: ## Find Your Community College Transfer Guide
L112: 
L113: Know your community college and the UMass Global program you want to pursue? Choose your school to view available Transfer Guides. These guides show how identified courses may fit into a specific UMass Global degree pathway.
L114: 
L115: Select a state, then choose your community college. On the next page, choose from the available program-specific PDF Transfer Guides.

L106: ## Launch your career with a versatile business administration degree
L107: 
L108: UMass Global’s online BBA degree covers a range of business topics, equipping you with job-ready skills for roles in marketing, finance, human resources, and more.
L109: 
L110: It’s a versatile degree, allowing you to tailor your studies to your interests and career goals. You’ll complete 33 credits through free electives, choosing from courses in accounting, computer science, entrepreneurship, finance, organizational leadership and more.
L111:   * Finish faster: Complete your degree faster thanks to our flexible transfer policy that allows you to transfer up to 90 credits from previous college coursework. That’s up to 75% of the qualifying credits needed to earn your degree.
L112:   * Choose the right approach for you: Ready to drive your own timeline and move as quickly as your mastery allows? This self-paced BBA is for you. Prefer structured weekly deadlines and peer interaction? Explore our 【57†instructor-led BBA】.
